eslint:react-hooks/exhaustive-deps.why: Effects deliberately narrower than their closure: mount-only restores, one-shot hydration, seed-once-per-step. The single largest class here and the one most worth reading twice — 39 places where the compiler's dependency analysis was overruled by hand. Retired by the same move each time: hoist the value into a ref or a stable callback so the honest dependency list is also the correct one.

directive:unreasoned.why: The second axis: an eslint directive with no `-- why` on its line. 17 of today's 59 explain themselves and 42 do not, which is the difference between a deliberate exception and one nobody has re-read. This ceiling can only fall, so a NEW suppression must carry its reason even when its rule still has room under the ceiling above.

eslint:react-hooks/set-state-in-effect.why: State seeded from a browser-only source (localStorage, sessionStorage, a URL param) in an effect, because doing it in an initializer would be an SSR hydration mismatch. Retired when the surface moves the read to the server or to a client-only boundary.

eslint:@next/next/no-img-element.why: Operator-supplied brand and customer logo URLs, which are arbitrary external hosts rather than bundled assets, so next/image would need every one of them in remotePatterns. Retired by routing tenant logos through a first-party image proxy.

eslint:i18next/no-literal-string.why: One deliberately English-only surface (app/trust) and one fold glyph that is punctuation rather than copy. Both carry their reason at the site. Retired when /trust is localized; the glyph one by making the character a named constant, which is structurally invisible to the rule.

eslint:react-hooks/refs.why: One guarded once-per-task hydration where the dirty flag must clear atomically with the state seed (useScheduleInterviewPrep). Documented at the site as the render-phase completion pattern.

eslint:jsx-a11y/media-has-caption.why: The JD-intake voice recorder's live audio element, which has no track to caption. Retired if the recorder ever renders a transcript alongside the stream.

eslint:*.why: A BLANKET `/* eslint-disable */` — every rule off for a whole file, naming none. The one occurrence is app/_dev-inspector/devInspectorUi.tsx, dev-only chrome behind DEV_INSPECT=1 that is deliberately outside the app's theming and i18n laws. Held at 1 because a second blanket disable should be a decision somebody makes on purpose, not a line somebody copies.

ts:@ts-expect-error.why: One test that deliberately drops a whole branch from a fixture to exercise a defensive read (app/_lib/voice/eleven-agent-diff.test.ts). `@ts-expect-error` rather than `@ts-ignore` on purpose: it fails if the error it claims stops happening. In product code this ceiling should stay at 1 and the occurrence should stay in a test.
